live_dispatch_observation_status.source_authority: typed observation outcome live_dispatch_calls and live_dispatch_started
live_dispatch_observation_status.derivation: Positive dispatch count plus explicit start is OBSERVED; zero plus explicit false is NOT_OBSERVED; otherwise UNKNOWN
live_dispatch_observation_status.unknown_semantics: The public record does not establish whether the live dispatch boundary was crossed
live_dispatch_observation_status.historical_compatibility: Legacy return_code fields never establish dispatch observation

live_process_observation_status.source_authority: typed observation outcome live_process_started and live_process_return_code
live_process_observation_status.derivation: Explicit process start is OBSERVED; explicit false is NOT_OBSERVED; missing lifecycle evidence is UNKNOWN
live_process_observation_status.unknown_semantics: Process lifecycle evidence was not recoverably captured
live_process_observation_status.historical_compatibility: Raw historical process fields remain provenance until typed scope is bound

inference_observation_status.derivation: Only an accepted marker yields OBSERVED; no marker after process observation is NOT_OBSERVED; pre-process is NOT_APPLICABLE_PRE_PROCESS
inference_observation_status.unknown_semantics: Inference cannot be classified from the available public observation; no private inference claim is made
inference_observation_status.historical_compatibility: Task140 live_inference_started is historical provenance, never canonical inference evidence

validated_completion_status.derivation: VALIDATED only after all task, executor, lease, workspace, capture, result and validator bindings pass
validated_completion_status.unknown_semantics: Validation was not run or exact binding cannot be established
validated_completion_status.historical_compatibility: Exit code, result presence or Agent self-report is insufficient

reconciliation_blocker_status.source_authority: Canonical reconciliation event ledger and typed attempt status
reconciliation_blocker_status.derivation: OPEN for unresolved attempts; NONE for known terminal/non-required states; UNKNOWN for missing or unrecognized status
reconciliation_blocker_status.unknown_semantics: A new live attempt is not authorized until reconciliation is repaired or explicitly closed
reconciliation_blocker_status.historical_compatibility: Repository evidence closure does not erase UNKNOWN external effect

next_eligible_action.source_authority: Pointfire policy projection over all other dimensions
next_eligible_action.derivation: Action is selected only after reconciliation, completion and admission gates remain separate
next_eligible_action.unknown_semantics: No safe next action can be authorized from current evidence
next_eligible_action.historical_compatibility: current_live_ceiling is a deprecated compatibility projection

claim_ceiling: Machine-readable repository-local state dimensions and derivation contract only; no inference, validated completion, external truth, production readiness, Owner acceptance or epistemic upgrade is inferred.
